targets.mini-books-fe: mini-books HTML pages -- the chart of accounts, an account, an entry, and the trial-balance and balance-sheet reports (Playwright)
targets.nager-api: date.nager.at public holidays API (no key) -- holiday-list equality and a business-day settlement date built on it
